page.notes: Scan is a single printed page, text only. Doubtful readings: "actibus" (ct ligature, read as [?]); "essen." in the first left note; the Suarez reference line is hard to read exactly. Long s is written as plain s throughout. A small "c" mark sits below the column at the lower left; it is probably a stray mark or signature and is not transcribed. Text ends on the hyphenated "la-", which continues on the next page. The "Jehovae" and "Jacksoni" forms follow the consonant I/J rule.
